newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends up on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends up on selective buying.

text.p: Shanghai B share index ended slightly up on Thursday due to some institutional speculation in selected stocks, but most investors remained sidelined waiting for market-moving news, brokers said.
They said though the index breached the resistance level of 69 points, follow-up buying was limited.
The B index rose 0.293 points or 0.43 percent to 69.019 on volume of 21.1 million shares worth $9.26 million.
"Institutional speculation in heavily weighted stocks pushed the index up, but most investors took a wait-and-see attitude, waiting for the release of 1996 annual reports," said a broker.
"Rises on the A share market encouraged domestic buying on the B share market," said one broker.

"Recent talk on restructuring state assets in state-owned listed companies and comments in the official media urging unlisted firms that make good profits to consider backdoor listings by acquiring shares in listed companies with poor results -- all this gave the market an excuse for some speculation in selected stocks," he said.
Brokers said they expected a clearer direction on Friday after two days' consolidation.
Of 43 B shares, 40 traded with 21 up, five flat and 14 down.
Hotel group Shanghai New Asia was the star on speculative buying, rising $0.032 or 7.8 percent to $0.442 on volume of 1.1 million shares.
Shanghai Vacuum and Electron Device traded the most, gaining $0.01 or 4.85 percent to $0.216 on volume 1.3 million shares.
Shanghai A shares ended sharply up with hot money flowing into the market to speculate in stocks expected to be subject to restructuring or selected for backdoor listings, brokers said.
The index jumped 28.876 points or 2.63 percent to 1,128.343 points on volume of 827 million shares worth 7.8 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index closed up 40.633 points or 1.44 percent to 2,860.959 points.
Fujian Fulian was the star on bargain-hunting, surging 0.69 yuan or 10.07 percent to 7.54 yuan on volume of 2.5 million shares.
